result.title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
result.summary: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReflectScene，用冻结 MLLM 结合多视图视觉证据诊断 3D 室内场景布局，并将诊断蒸馏为轻量 Reward Predictor 以决定物体级修正，再通过条件化扩散在去噪过程中闭环地施加修正并保持非目标布局不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 「诊断—决策—修正」闭环以及把 MLLM 评估蒸馏成轻量判别器来选择修正动作，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、修正决策与停止/保持的取舍提供可核查线索，但其任务是 3D 场景生成而非推理本身，联系较间接。
